How it works

  1. Create a leaderboard and add the players.
  2. Set point buttons that fit your game — or type each round's score into the rounds table.
  3. Press “End game” to crown the winner. The result is saved in the history.

Why Punkto

Does the maths for you

Totals, ranks and round scores are calculated automatically — no more adding-up mistakes.

Minus points too

Many games take points away. Set your own minus buttons or type negative scores.

A history of every game

Keep a record of past games and see who won last time.

Private by design: names and scores are stored only in your browser — nothing is uploaded.

Questions & answers

Which games does it work for?

Any game where players collect points: card games, board games, darts, bowling, mini golf, video game tournaments and more.

What if the lowest score wins?

Punkto ranks the highest total first. For games where the lowest score wins, enter the points as negative numbers.

Does it work on my phone?

Yes. The control view is made for phones, and Punkto works offline after the first visit.
